item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0037-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0037-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The excerpt reports median annual inflation expectations through November 2023: the first reported series declines from 5.28 percent in February to 4.54 percent in November, while the second reported series is 5.40 percent in February and 5.16 percent in November.","notes":["The excerpt says the figures are as of November 2023, not that this is a December 2023 table.","The supplied excerpt does not label the two series as general and core inflation, so those attributions were narrowed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0037-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0037-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0037-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
